thread:
Priya Shah: Heads up — several hiring managers are reporting that the scorecard they see in the hiring dashboard shows v2 questions, but interviewers in the interviewer app are getting v1. Noticed after last night's scorecard-deploy.
Aisha Khan: Uh oh. How many interviews?
Priya Shah: Anecdotal reports from 6 teams. Can we query for interviews where scorecard_version != assigned_interviewer_scorecard_version?
Erik Lin: Good call. Quick query: ```SELECT i.id, i.candidate_email, i.job_slug, i.scheduled_at, i.scorecard_version, s.version AS interviewer_version FROM interviews i LEFT JOIN interviewer_assignments s ON s.interview_id=i.id WHERE i.created_at>='2026-07-01' AND i.scorecard_version<>s.version;```
Recruiting Bot: Query queued — est rows: 48.
Maya Rodriguez: If that's true, interviewers may be grading against a different rubric than hiring managers review. We should pause scorecard submission until we reconcile.
Aisha Khan: Pausing submission now for impacted job_slugs. Also tagging Legal for any fairness concerns. @Legal Bot please advise if we need candidate notifications.
Legal Bot: Reviewing. If grading inconsistency affects shortlist decisions, we may need to surface a note to stakeholders. Will update in 30m.
Erik Lin: Root cause looks like a deploy race where the template cache was updated in the web UI worker but not invalidated for mobile-worker pool. The cache key uses template_id but our deploy renamed the slug for v2. I'll push a cache-invalidation hotfix.
Priya Shah: Plan: 1) Pause submissions; 2) Run the mismatch query and export list for hiring managers + interviewers; 3) Backfill interviewer assignments to the canonical version (prefer the version that matched scheduled_at); 4) Reopen submissions and add short note in review UI about version used.
Maya Rodriguez: I'll draft comms to interviewers + hiring managers explaining the fix and asking anyone who noticed odd questions to flag them. Draft in #people-ops-drafts.
Erik Lin: Pushing hotfix to invalidate cache and force template reload for all workers. Also adding an e2e test that deploys a mock scorecard rename and asserts both web and mobile pools see same version.
Recruiting Bot: Hotfix deployed to staging. Running mismatch query now.
Aisha Khan: Exported report looks like 48 interviews affected across 12 job_slugs. We'll backfill to version tagged at schedule time. Samir (cc) — can you run the idempotent backfill and attach logs?
Recruiting Bot: Backfill job scheduled: job_id=rb-2026-07-05-09:12, est updates: 48.
Priya Shah: Thanks. Retro items: require deploy checklist step for template slug renames, add cache invalidation to deployment playbook, and add a monitoring alert for scorecard-version drift.
Maya Rodriguez: Comms draft ready; legal approved language. Sending after backfill completes.
Aisha Khan: Backfill finished, 48/48 reconciled. Re-opening submissions. Closing loop once hiring managers confirm reviews are aligned. :thumbsup:
